title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 13
description: Ten questions on Exodus 13: the firstborn set apart, the feast of unleavened bread and the pillars of cloud and fire.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Moses to sanctify to him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to sanctify to him all the firstborn among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal, for it is his.

questions.text: In which month did the people go out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Moses told the people: 'Today you go out in the month Abib.'

questions.text: How is the land Yahweh swore to give them described?
questions.explanation: It is described as the land of the Canaanite, Hittite, Amorite, Hivite and Jebusite, a land flowing with milk and honey.

answers.text: A land full of gold and silver
A land covered with olive groves
A land rich in wheat and barley
A land flowing with milk and honey

questions.text: What were the people to tell their son on the day of the feast?
questions.explanation: They were to tell their son: 'It is because of that which Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt.'

answers.text: It is a custom handed down from our fathers of old
Because of what Yahweh did for me when I came out of Egypt
It is to remember the day our fathers came to Canaan
It is to mark the start of the barley harvest each year

questions.text: With what was every firstborn donkey to be redeemed?
questions.explanation: Every firstborn of a donkey was to be redeemed with a lamb.

questions.text: What was to be done to a firstborn donkey that was not redeemed?
questions.explanation: If the firstborn donkey was not redeemed, its neck was to be broken.

answers.text: It was sold to a foreigner
It was released into the wilderness
Its neck was to be broken

questions.text: Why did God not lead the people by the way of the land of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: Although that way was near, God said: 'Lest perhaps the people change their minds when they see war, and they return to Egypt.'

answers.text: Because the way was too long
Because there was no water on that road
Lest they see war and return to Egypt

questions.text: Which way did God lead the people instead?
questions.explanation: God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea, and they went up armed out of Egypt.

answers.text: Along the banks of the Nile
By the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea
Along the coast of the Great Sea

questions.text: What did Moses take with him out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him, because Joseph had made the children of Israel swear to carry up his bones.

questions.text: How did Yahweh go before the people by night?
questions.explanation: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light.

answers.text: As an angel carrying a torch
In the light of the full moon
